theme: mesh health board: soft dial → local EXCHANGE fallback → peer_decide → STATUS

tests.name: soft_dial_local_fallback
tests.note: remote soft-fail then mesh_exchange + CLEAR_ERR; exit 0

tests.name: strict_after_recovery
tests.note: exit 0 only because CLEAR_ERR after intentional FAIL

tests.name: hard_dial_no_soft
tests.note: expected hard fail at SMX DIAL — cannot recover in-program without host soft flag

weaknesses.title: Soft dial cannot be enabled from CubalC source
weaknesses.detail: SYS ENV CUBALC_P2P_SOFT OR "1" only reads into LAST; DIAL soft-fail is gated solely by host getenv. Agents must shell-export CUBALC_P2P_SOFT=1. Reading soft into LET does not affect SMX DIAL.
weaknesses.repro: unset CUBALC_P2P_SOFT; run mesh_health_board → fatal DIAL connect even if program sets LET soft

weaknesses.title: SYS CAT is 2-arg only; multi-arg and numeric vars fail opaquely
weaknesses.detail: SYS CAT a b c parses leftover as unknown form. SYS CAT "x=" n with numeric LET n fails unknown form 'n'. No documented multi-arg join; forms/search omit SYS CAT/STRCAT entirely.

weaknesses.title: SYS WRITE paths ignore CUBALC_STATE
weaknesses.detail: SYS STATE returns the state dir, but SYS WRITE "MESH_HEALTH_BOARD.txt" writes cwd-relative, not under CUBALC_STATE. Agents cannot safely place plates without absolute path glue (and no join of sdir+name that accepts numbers/paths cleanly).
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_STATE=/tmp/x cubalc run … → file appears in repo cwd not /tmp/x

weaknesses.title: STATUS ok vs sticky last_err after intentional FAIL then PASS
weaknesses.detail: Without CLEAR_ERR, STATUS can report status ok=1 while last_err still holds FAIL text from a recovered soft path. -s mode exits 1 despite recovery. CLEAR_ERR is required but easy to forget.
weaknesses.repro: FAIL then PASS then STATUS without CLEAR_ERR; run -s

weaknesses.title: String plane invisible to forms/search
weaknesses.detail: SYS CAT/STRCAT/FIND exist in lang_ops_core but cubalc forms CAT and search concat/string do not list them. Agents invent broken multi-arg CAT from cookbook silence.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc forms CAT → n=0; cubalc search concat → n=0

weaknesses.title: Quiet mode still dies on late parse/form errors after good work
weaknesses.detail: Program ran full mesh+decide successfully then failed at end on bad SYS CAT — expensive success discarded. No partial plate commit for late errors.
weaknesses.repro: original board with multi-arg SYS CAT after STATUS

workarounds: Always export CUBALC_P2P_SOFT=1 from host for probe boards
Pairwise SYS CAT strings only; stringify numbers via known string vars or avoid
CLEAR_ERR after intentional soft FAIL if using run -s
Use PRINT_JSON/STATUS for agent output; treat SYS WRITE as cwd-relative only
Discover string ops by grepping sources until forms catalog is complete
language_gaps: In-language set of soft-dial / soft-serve flags (or SMX DIAL SOFT form)
SYS CAT multi-arg or SYS FMT / interpolation for plate bodies
Numeric-to-string in CAT or PRINT formatting
SYS WRITE under STATE by default or SYS WRITE STATE "name" body
Catalog SYS string plane in forms/search/HELP
